# SSLMate Cert Spotter API

Cert Spotter API by SSLMate monitors Certificate Transparency logs to alert users about SSL/TLS certificates issued for their domains, helping detect unauthorized certificates and potential security issues.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sslmate-cert-spotter-api/.

## Actions

- **Get CertSpotter Event** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific certspotter event.
- **List Monitored Domains** (read-only): List all monitored domains.
- **Retrieve Webhook Settings** (read-only): Retrieve webhook settings.
